exposure: controlled hypotension (within 5 min of MAP down to 70% of basal blood pressure)
outcome: Apgar score at 1 min and 5 min
cohort: 75 pregnant women with high-risk hemorrhage undergoing cesarean section
finding: In pregnant women with high-risk hemorrhage undergoing cesarean section, controlled hypotension reduced intraoperative blood loss and red blood cell transfusions without negatively impacting neonatal outcomes.
